description: Small authored gate-level replay set: 10 cases, four APPROVE, five DENY, one UNCERTAIN. Same failure families across development and held-out with new values/paraphrases. Labels require independent review. Includes a real stock-tool contract mismatch; not a representative AgentDojo sample or an acting-agent attack benchmark.
